content: Hello, I am Cedar Insurance's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Robin Hale?
Yes, this is Robin Hale speaking.
Before we continue, I need to confirm your identity. Could you please tell me your policyholder code?
Could you please tell me your postcode?
Thank you. I am calling about overdue insurance premiums. Your insurance policy has 480.00 past due and is 8 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amount today?
No, I can't pay the full 480 today, I'm afraid. I have 120 pounds I can put toward it now. I'm also waiting on a client payment that might come around October 20th, but that isn't guaranteed.
I cannot record 120.00. The minimum is 160.00. Could you pay 160.00 on Wednesday 14 October 2026? The remaining balance stays overdue.
I'm sorry, but I only have 120 pounds available right now, so I can't commit to 160 today. I don't want to promise money I haven't got. Is there any other option that works with 120?
I'm sorry, I don't have that information. Could you pay 160.00 for the insurance policy on Thursday 15 October 2026? The remaining balance stays overdue.

No, I'll still only have 120 on Thursday, and that won't change before the 19th. I could only manage more after the 20th if my client actually pays, and I can't guarantee that, so I can't agree to 160.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
